title: Sky Blue: Burn-Rate Analytics and Runway Projections
summary: This document explains how Sky Blue includes burn-rate analytics at no extra cost and how to use the analytics dashboard to review monthly spend, inflows, and net burn. It also covers the runway projections tool forecasting up to 18 months, how to refine projections with categorization/filters and reconcile transactions, and how to export visuals for stakeholder sharing.
